title: List Edge Coloring conjecture
statement: List Edge Coloring conjecture · Vizing 1975 and Erdős–Rubin–Taylor 1979. Every graph’s list chromatic index equals its ordinary chromatic index.

counterexample.description: A bounded refutation supplies a simple nonbipartite graph and one explicit list of χ′(G) colors per edge for which no proper list edge-coloring exists. A complete check computes χ′(G) and exhausts the provided list assignment.
